Kool I like this. Let me start off the discussion on global politics and economics by saying that the government asserts partial ownership over everything within its boundaries. It owns partially owns your land, your company, your labor, and even you. In exchange for this ownership the government provides services that companies in the free market could provide without asserting ownership over you. The amount of taxes collected is proportional to your freedom level. How free would you like to be?

But governments also have a responsibility to their constituents in the spirit of Nobilis Oblige, in that they profit and prosper on the common man. I feel this is forgotten in many modern Democracies and leads to your mentioned catch 22, you need the government to keep the road, courts, and water running but how much is that worth and who decides that?

I think that a free and sovereign individual should be able to decide for manself the value of certain goods and services and decide if those products are worth the price. Person A can not dictate to a free individual B whether or not a good or product is worth it to person B and then force them to pay for it. Dictating laws for others to follow on penalties of excommunication is fine, but dictating how another should sort and act on their values is a violation of freedom in the same way that dictating how another should spend his or her quiet time in reflection is a violation of freedom.

I actually discovered this one by accident! Personally, I find this to be particularly useful if you have Voat in one window (or monitor) and your link in the other. Instead of clicking share-a-link and then copying and pasting your link, you can easily share a link by doing the following:

  1. Have your link open in your browser.
  2. To the left of your actual URL should be either an icon of some sort, usually a lock or something else depending on what site. Click and drag this over your window or tab with Voat. Here's an example of me doing it with Voat.co .
  3. Once you let go of your mouse button, Voat should automatically have a post with your link! Just add a title and you're good to go.

This also works with images! As long as they've been uploaded somewhere else beforehand, you should be good. I haven't tested this with any other browser than Chrome, but I would assume that it works in other browsers too. I've tried to highlight the link and drag that into Voat, but that doesn't seem to work unlike dragging the link's icon when in-browser. Yes, this doesn't honestly save that much time, but hey: time is time. :)
LPT: Want to quickly share links? Skip copying and pasting your link by simply dragging it into Voat!

Too bad it also responds to dragging text, and it won't go away unless you reload the page.

Edit: Or if you press escape while dragging, apparantly.
